name: return-stmt-negative-test-c1f15d4b97/not-enough-args-to-return-3-e.bal
reason: The case expects rejection of a comma-separated return with only two expressions for a three-member tuple return type. Function definitions, return statements, ordinary calls, variable references and string literals are supported; rejecting this malformed return is within the supported grammar/type system. No subset restriction excludes this negative behavior.
test_design_notes: The two @error annotations assert compile-time rejection; the comma-separated return is illegal syntax, not a required supported multi-value-return feature.
